name: incident-response
title_zh: 生产事故处置规范：先定边界再动手修
tagline_zh: 代理一上来就抢修？先让它学会：事故当下先确认影响面与证据链，再谈修复——否则越修越乱。
tagline_en: Agents rushing to fix? Teach them: establish impact & evidence first, then propose fixes—or chaos ensues.
desc_en: How this team handles a production incident issue — what to establish before proposing a fix, and what an agent may and may not do on its own.
why_zh: 内置团队真实事故流程，强制代理先做状态确认与影响分级，禁止未经许可的写操作，从机制上防止乱改。
why_en: Encodes real incident protocol: mandates impact assessment & read-only first, blocks unauthorized writes—prevents reckless.
limit_zh: 仅覆盖生产事故的初始响应阶段（确认、定级、提议），不含具体修复执行；需要团队已有事故响应手册或值班流程。
limit_en: Covers initial response only (triage, classify, propose), no fix execution; requires existing incident playbook or on-call flow, else agent just.
